walls.note: Plaque side: the fallen tree against the rubble wall, branches reaching to the paving (Commons, Ceescamel).

items.where: bronze cast of a felled tree lying on the paving: bent trunk about 7 m, a dozen branches sweeping down to the ground, splayed roots at the right end
items.how: builder: five tapered trunk segments, nine main limbs with three knuckles and a twig each, seven roots; the branching is procedural, not a scan

items.where: separate bronze stump about 1.2 m high with a splintered crown behind the root end
items.how: builder: tapered cylinder with six cone splinters

items.where: bronze plaque cast as weathered boards in the paving: WALRAVEN VAN HALL / BANKIER VAN HET VERZET / 1906 - 1945 (and a web address, omitted)
items.how: builder: bronze slab with three lines of raised stroke-font capitals laid for the reader; the web address line is omitted, the board grain is not carved

items.where: curved rubble-stone wall about 0.85 m high behind the tree, brick circle with a stone kerb
items.how: builder: 34 irregular wall blocks on an arc, 32 kerb stones, brick disc

walls.note: Side: the circle seen through the park trees (panorama 02947).
Back: stump and the wall from outside.

sources.name: Ceescamel, Walraven van Hall (zijaanzicht1, zijaanzicht2, achteraanzicht, detail1, plaat)
